reviews.title: Don’t Understand
reviews.text: I have used the free version for years and decided to upgrade to the paid (paid for one time “lifetime” payment) version and not only did I not get any new features, I still get asked if I want to upgrade every time I open the app.  Incredibly frustrating and assume I should just delete and write off the payment.

reviews.title: This app has become horrible
reviews.text: This app used to be a pleasure to use. Recently it has changed from useful to torture. I could accept the requests to purchase the full app. But now, there is a button to open ads right next to the “x” to clear the input numbers so that if your finger is inaccurate by a fraction of a millimeter, you are trapped in an inescapable cascade of ads that doesn’t respond to your attempts to close. It is maddening.

reviews.title: Nothing but non stop ads
reviews.text: This app used to be ok but it’s just a non stop ad fest now.  Don’t use
